learning_outcomes.text: Understand the importance of volume molds in industry.
Learn the importance of plastic molds.
Recognize and learn hot forging dies.
Ensure the determination of material weight and dimensions of the material to be placed in hot forging dies.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to volume molding, types of volume molding
Types of plastic materials used in volume molding
Materials used in metal injection molds
Hot and cold chamber metal injection machines
Hot chamber metal injection mold design
Cold chamber metal injection mold design
Cooling elements used in volume molding
Hot forging dies and machines used in hot forging
Open and closed hot forging dies
assessment_rules: The midterm exam accounts for 40% of the grade, and the final exam accounts for 60% of the grade. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
